items.title: Welcome new students on day one
items.description: What the admissions team does on the first day of orientation.
items.body:
# When to use this

On the first day of orientation for a new intake.

# Steps

1. Open the welcome desk before the first session.
2. Hand out student ID cards.
3. Walk each group to its first session.

# Related

- [Enrollment](/_themes/enrollment.md)
